comparison.objective: Remove a flat drill battery and install the charged one until latched.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a release button while sliding one pack out, then align and insert another along a rail; the candidate instead uses a hex key, fine collar rotation, and bounded locking torque.
comparison.success_condition: Charged pack fully home, latched, released, and still; squeezing without the button fails. Candidate success requires two quantified impact cycles and post-lock setting stability.
comparison.reason: Both include retention mechanisms and bimanual coordination, but battery exchange tests release-plus-rail insertion, not iterative dynamic tuning and relocking.
